title: FreeAgent Training on Smart Capture
description: Free Training on FreeAgent's new Smart Capture feature on 22 February 2024 at 5pm.
author: Barry Adams
html:
We have arranged an hour of free, FreeAgent training focusing on 'Smart Capture'

Smart Capture is a new and improved version of the Auto Extract feature which automatically extracts the date and amount from your receipts and uploads them to your account.

The training will focus on the time-saving benefits of using Smart Capture.

There will be the opportunity to ask any questions that you may have and gain further clarity if you are unsure of anything.

The training session will take place on Zoom on Thursday 22nd February at 5pm and will last for approximately 1 hour.

If you're interested, please register today:

Register here

After registering, you will be sent an email confirmation with the Zoom ID and password and please pass the signup link onto anyone who may also be interested in the training.

We will be recording the training session and will make the webinar accessible from our website.

Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

We look forward to seeing you there!
